featured_reviews.review_text:
Actually we have visited this store based on review but goods are much expensive then other shops.Initllay they give great deal but after every purchase they are adjusting their price in some other stuffs and also they gave variations in every bills.But after caught they are giving excuse by blaming poor helpers.
Their product quality varies post delivery. I haven't got any branded goods as margin are less for branded so I won't suggest anyone to go for this shop with local quality goods. Look and feel for good are bright but those are local goods and not for long term.Totally disappointed.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Sorry for the inconvenience Mam. But we never came across such customer yet infact our customers are totally satisfied with the product  and price. Kindly visit the store if you have  and issue regarding the product and pricing as our rates are way to reasonable  as compare to the market  and 95% product are branded talking about the 5% are for the customer who ask for less pricing  but we still refere them brand  stuff . You can visit  the store and we can solve your issue. Thank you

featured_reviews.name: Amit Bari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Collections is ok ok and helper staff is also polite but rates are different for different clients and contractors. Rates will be already provided at high to new customers and after bargain also you won't be able to settle at appropriate rate. They will apply their marketing skills to get stuck with their attractive  product but beware guys as those goods are not quality ones just for basic usage.Kindly check at different shops and then conclude the final rate n quality.
Nitin himself told me to check at other stores and not to call him for any products.How can a client tolerate such arrogant and rude behaviour.Being a client we have a lot of options and it's important to bring this to notice for others.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello amit sir..
As you have mentioned  about the rates differ. Its different for the bulk purchase and for single purchase. We have displayed  all the product  starting from high  end and so on.As our customers have different choices and different budget so as a sales person its our responsibility  to keep all the products according to the range. If you want high end or budget product  you can visit  the store sir. We are happy to attend you.
Thank you

featured_reviews.review_text: Smart Bazaar is a convenient place for everyday shopping. The store is well-organized, and you can find a good variety of groceries, household items, and daily essentials in one place. Billing is usually quick, and the overall shopping experience is smooth. A reliable store for regular needs.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Mewada
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Reliance Smart Bazaar in Virar West (formerly Big Bazaar) and had a mixed experience. The store is spacious, well-stocked, and offers good variety in groceries, household items, and fresh produce. Prices and offers are decent, but billing took longer due to limited counters during peak hours. Some price labels were unclear, so it’s better to double-check at checkout. Overall, a convenient place for regular shopping, but faster billing and clearer pricing would improve the experience.
